mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the risk-free rate and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS trend and SPX returns is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that may trigger corporate earnings cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or joint decline signal rank correlation with negative returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0, which signals a contraction in manufacturing output, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or average return in these periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or rank correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and SPX returns is above 0.05 in triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or rank correlation between RSAFS trend and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or joint signal rank correlation with negative returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 97.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0 for two consecutive months, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
